items.s2_1: I take an umbrella on rainy days.
items.s2_2: The weather is cool in the morning.
items.s2_3: We can see snow in winter.
items.passage: Today is Wednesday. The weather is cloudy and cool. Amy wears a jacket to school. She has an umbrella in her bag because it may rain later. At lunch, the wind is strong. Amy and her friends stay inside and read books. After school, the sky is sunny again.
